subject: Access ownership alignment for SOC 2 artifact delivery
messages:
From: Sam Henderson <sam.henderson@cyrexhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@cyrexhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask: SCIM / SAML ownership and artifact handoff

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team started the SOC 2 v2 intake and asked for a short deliverable: a mapping of who owns provisioning for Cyrex identities (SCIM service account, SSO assertion origin, and RBAC owners), plus a small sample of SCIM delta logs and a couple of SAML assertion examples to validate audience and attributes.

Can you confirm:
- Which Redwood service account performs SCIM writes for customer tenants?
- Where SAML assertions originate (idp vs. proxy) for hosted customers?
- Owner contacts for role assignment and RBAC policy reviews?

We don't need a full export — just a brief ownership matrix and a 24-hour SCIM delta sample and two SAML assertion excerpts redacted for PII. Can you target this week? Our audit kickoff is next Tuesday.

Cheers,
Sam Henderson
Security Engineer — Cyrex Health

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sam Henderson <sam.henderson@cyrexhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: SCIM / SAML ownership and artifact handoff

Hi Sam —

Appreciate the clear list. Yes, we can provide the ownership matrix + sample artifacts. Quick answers inline, and I'll follow up with attachments once Laura signs off on the redaction manifest.

- SCIM writes: done by a tenant-scoped service account (internal id: s-scim-writer). We will include the runbook snippet and the owner as the infra team.
- SAML assertions: originate from the customer's IdP and pass through our assertion gateway; we’ll include a trace showing assertion metadata and the gateway's validation steps.
- RBAC owners: role assignment is owned by customer admins by default; for managed roles we’ll list the product team owners.

Target: I can get a draft package to you by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-18). Are there any strict redaction rules you need beyond removing PHI and email addresses?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-15T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial ask: SCIM / SAML ownership and artifact handoff

Marissa / Sean —

Please treat the SCIM sample and SAML excerpts as sensitive. I approve sharing redacted artifacts for SOC 2 review but want the following controls in place before we send:
- Produce a redaction manifest listing every field removed/hashed.
- Deliver samples over the secure drive link and limit to security@cyrexhealth.com only (no broader cc).
- Remove any internal trace IDs linked to customer billing tokens.

Sean, can you prepare the SCIM delta sample (24-hour window) and extract two SAML assertion snippets with subject/email fields hashed? Add a brief line stating how long logs are retained and where they live (e.g., encrypted S3 bucket, 90-day retention for deltas).

Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sam Henderson <sam.henderson@cyrexhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: SCIM / SAML ownership and artifact handoff

On Mon, May 17, 2027 at 08:30 AM marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Sam — attaching the artifact bundle as discussed (redacted). Please confirm receipt.

Hi all —

Attached: scim_sync_log_sample.csv (24-hour delta), saml_assertions_excerpt.txt (2 assertions with email/hash removed), redaction_manifest.xlsx (fields removed and justification). Files uploaded to: https://redwood-inference.app/drive/Shared/Compliance/Cyrex_SOC2_Packets (secured link).

Retention note: SCIM deltas are retained 90 days in encrypted object storage; production audit traces are kept 12 months for operational troubleshooting and require a compliance request to export.

Attachment stubs: [scim_sync_log_sample.csv (CSV, 120KB)], [saml_assertions_excerpt.txt (TXT, 4KB)], [redaction_manifest.xlsx (XLSX, 8KB)].

Let us know if you need additional attributes (e.g., group membership syncs) or a signed attestation for the retention policy.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Technical Account Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Henderson <sam.henderson@cyrexhealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: SCIM / SAML ownership and artifact handoff

Hi Sean / Marissa —

Got the package and the drive link — thanks for the fast turnaround and the manifest. A couple small follow-ups before we close the intake:
- Can you confirm the service account name again (you mentioned s-scim-writer)? We need the exact principal to include in our control mapping.
- For the SAML gateway, can you add a one-line explanation of how assertion audience checks are enforced (gateway config + sample assertion field)?
- We'll accept the artifacts to security@cyrexhealth.com only.

If you can drop a short note (1–2 sentences) answering those three points I'll mark the item resolved on our tracker and the auditor will proceed.

Best,
Sam Henderson
Security Engineer — Cyrex Health
